### Fixed
- The kagent cilium network policies open egress from the kagent controller and from the kagent-managed agent pods to kagent's built-in tool server when it is enabled (`kagent.kagent-tools.enabled: true`): the `app.kubernetes.io/name: kagent-tools` pods in the tools namespace on the tools port (8084; an explicit `kagent.kagent-tools.namespaceOverride` / `service.ports.tools.targetPort` is honoured). `kagent-controller-egress` and `kagent-agent-muster-egress` are default-deny egress lists, so the controller's tool discovery (MCP initialize + tools/list on the `kagent-tool-server` RemoteMCPServer URL) and the agents' tool calls were dropped as `Policy denied`: the RemoteMCPServer stayed `Accepted=False` and every agent that referenced it ran without tools. Nothing renders for installations with the tool server off (the default). `make verify-kagent-netpol` (in CI) pins the rules both ways.
